messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social behaviour and attitudes, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and Elections in Germany during the 1990s, matching this research need: Survey data on German voters before the 1998 federal election, covering party identification, vote intentions, government and opposition evaluations, issue competence, political attitudes, social values, EU identity, and demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
